saisie.panneau.a_saisir_confirmer: Clear the value of this cell? It goes back to “to fill in”. The comment and the evidence stay.
saisie.cellule.msg.remise_a_saisir: Value cleared: the cell is “to fill in” again.
saisie.msg.rien_a_effacer: There is no entered value to clear in this cell.
saisie.panneau.retour_aide_brouillon: Draft: the value stays and must be validated again.
saisie.panneau.retour_aide_effacer: Clear: the cell goes back to “to fill in” (comment and evidence kept).
saisie.auto.valide: This value is validated. It changes only when you select Save the change.
saisie.auto.ambigu: “{saisie}” can be read two ways. Select Save the draft to choose.
saisie.js.auto_valide: Not saved yet. A validated value changes only when you save it.
saisie.js.auto_ambigu: Not saved yet: “{saisie}” can be read two ways. Select Save the draft to choose.
saisie.js.auto_conflit: someone else changed this entry. Save to replace their value, or close without saving.
saisie.js.auto_garde: The draft saved at {heure} is kept.
saisie.panneau.annuler_auto_titre: Puts back the value, the N/A box and the comment as they were when you opened this entry
saisie.ligne.type.agrege_titre: Consolidated: the tool adds up (or combines) the values of the attached organisations. Nobody enters it.
saisie.coherence.regle.recommande_aide: Recommended: {niveau}, the most detailed level where all the KPIs of the rule have a value.
saisie.coherence.regle.trop_fin: Some KPIs of the rule have no value at this level.
saisie.msg.na_interdit: Your role cannot answer “N/A”. Enter a value, or ask an administrator.
saisie.panneau.na_reserve: N/A set by an administrator: only an allowed role can remove it.
saisie.org.tout_attribue_aide: All your organisations, one after the other
saisie.filtre.codes_aide: Shows the code of each KPI under its name. The choice is kept in this browser.
saisie.choix.rechercher: Search for a period or a framework
saisie.js.aucun_code: Paste at least one KPI code.
saisie.fiche.niveaux_superieurs_aide: How the tool gets the value of the organisations above the entry level.
saisie.fiche.creer_dans_aide: The KPI is added at the end of this theme. Choose “—” to leave it outside any framework.
saisie.fiche.place_avant: The KPI will be placed just before {code} – {nom}.
saisie.fiche.place_apres: The KPI will be placed just after {code} – {nom}.
saisie.fiche.regler_types_titre: Names, labels and colours: Frameworks and KPIs › Units and formats › Entry types
saisie.fiche.traduire_titre: Do you want to translate this KPI?
saisie.fiche.traduire_aide: The name or some descriptions are missing in another language. Without a translation, the tool shows them in the default language.
saisie.tableau.aide: One row per item. In a list column, type a few letters to filter the choices. Empty rows are ignored.
saisie.tableau.aide_markdown: Write one row per line, cells separated by “|”, in the order of the columns.
saisie.fiche.confidentialite_aide: “Restricted” and “Confidential” make the KPI sensitive: its evidence files are offered for deletion once the retention period (Settings › Hosting) has passed. An administrator confirms every deletion.
saisie.ia.avertissement: The AI can be wrong. Check before you use this text.
saisie.ia.refus.calcul: A calculation that cannot be made has nothing to explain: check the sources of the KPI.
saisie.ia.refus.sensible: This alert names a sensitive KPI: nothing is sent to the AI assistant. An administrator can allow sensitive KPIs in Settings › AI assistant.
saisie.js.ia.echec: The AI assistant did not answer. Try again.

saisie.js.ia.propositions.one: {n} proposal from AI ({fournisseur}). Check it before you use it.
saisie.js.ia.propositions.other: {n} proposals from AI ({fournisseur}). Check each one before you use it.

saisie.js.selection_perdue.one: The selected cell will be deselected. Change the group of organisations?
saisie.js.selection_perdue.other: The {n} selected cells will be deselected. Change the group of organisations?

saisie.attribuer.validateur_retire.one: {utilisateur} is no longer validator for {n} cell.
saisie.attribuer.validateur_retire.other: {utilisateur} is no longer validator for {n} cells.

saisie.fiche.depuis_question: Add it to previous years too?
saisie.fiche.depuis_aide: By default, from the current period: no past year changes. A closed year gets the KPI when you reopen it.
saisie.forcage.importee_justification: Figure imported as is, kept as an overridden value.
saisie.forcage.msg.importee_changee: This cell changed in the meantime. Reload the page.
saisie.forcage.msg.importee_forcee: {kpi} · {organisation}: the imported figure is now an overridden value.
saisie.forcage.msg.importee_retiree: {kpi} · {organisation}: the imported figure is removed; the cell shows the calculated result.

saisie.forcage.page.importees.one: {n} imported figure on a calculated cell

saisie.forcage.page.importees_aide: These figures were imported before overridden values existed for imports. The calculation uses them only when it cannot calculate the cell. Force them to keep them, or remove them to use the calculated result.
saisie.forcage.page.importee_forcer_aria: Force the imported figure of {kpi} for {organisation}
saisie.forcage.page.importee_retirer_ari: Remove the imported figure of {kpi} for {organisation}
